selection: Original C/header/art source plus Makefile/README. No generated objects/binaries/logs/OS/VCS/docs.

files.reason: Stop the collision pair iterator at the list tail before dereferencing the next node, including empty/single lists. Actual owning three-pair/empty/single fixture with null sanitizer traps original; fixed preserves each pair exactly once. Independently initialize missing saved highscore to zero; poisoned Game fixture original exposes uninitialized score, fixed defaults0 and still reads existing150/date. Ordinary optimized native collision code can eliminate the invalid unused read, so this is a proven source UB repair, not a claimed Android crash. Added a per-type payload release helper and call it before removeLinkedElement on both removal paths. Enemy deletion also clears bullet origin pointers that reference the freed gun so no stale origins remain. Player and the player's separately listed cursor sprite are left owned by the player, avoiding double frees.

Initialize current_image0 in both original gun constructors before updateGunAnimation unconditionally indexes the four-frame table. Independently poisoned malloc makes original constructor-to-animation owner fail its idle-frame precondition; fixed actual idle frame0 and next shooting frame1 pass. Existing gun sprite already starts on pistol0; this guarantees the authored idle frame without depending on fresh zeroed heap. No aiming, projectile, cooldown, movement or art changes. This is a genuine uninitialized source state defect on original Minix too, not an emulator adaptation or proven explanation of current native aiming failure.
Update firstElement when the removed node is the head so the list cannot keep a dangling pointer.

controlsRationale: Auto-orientation external panel preserves the original800x600 arena. WASD hold state controls movement; game time advances normally while moving and slows while idle. Relative unit pointer starts at original400,400. Fire is an original tap-to-shoot action, not an invented autofire. Enter starts/restarts, ESC quits. No direct calibration or source movement/fire adaptation. Explicit build.sources selects original letters.c despite the authored Makefile naming a nonexistent letters.cpp; no C++ rewrite or Makefile change.

nativeGameplay.demonstrated: ROOT reviewed complementary same-APK Android runs: original Enter/held movement, red enemy and ordinary aiming/Fire producing actual live SCORE100, persisted original Highscore100 on a fresh launch, and a separate normal arena run with clean authored Escape returning to the same library.
limitations: A complete campaign and physical-phone performance are not demonstrated. The successful scored run hit a QA output-path conversion error after its helper captured100; its raw failed QA result is preserved, not relabeled. Clean exit is established by a separate same-APK run. Other ordinary-input trials lost naturally at0 and remain recorded. No rules, aim, projectile speed or enemy behavior was changed.
